Re-run browser fixture matrix after fix: admin picker visible, agent no-picker, role 403, and conversation/edit/save mocked workflows.
Keep isolated interception complete for Supabase/Auth/Edge/OSRM; no real CRM writes were executed in this run.

GPTour UI assumes happy-path shape for agent list data; a malformed payload currently causes full-screen crash instead of safe fallback.
Added focused isolated tests for adapter gaps: incomplete edge payload rejection and reconcile partial lookup no-second-batch behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: vitest 178/178, tsc pass, Expo JS exports for iOS+Android pass with --no-bytecode. Browser isolated run validated fixture login and role 403 gate. Remaining gap is admin GPTour flow due runtime crash before picker assertions.
rca_of_issue: Repro: login fixture admin -> open /ai-tour -> tap GPTour card. Result: red-screen `agents.find is not a function` at app/gptour.tsx line ~48. Root cause: component directly uses `.find/.map` on `agents` without runtime shape guarding. Mitigation: normalize fetched data (`const safeAgents = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []`) and render warning if malformed.
